list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them; kinds, stages, hidden and missable markings built from those descriptions.

stages.title: First light in Leonida
stages.blurb: Play the opening straight through. Gone Fishing teaches the water, the roads and the wanted system, and Chapter 1 puts both protagonists on the map. Nothing here can be missed — just finish the missions as they come.

stages.title: The map opens up
stages.blurb: Chapters 2 and 3 widen the world. While the story is still young, sample every activity type once (Master of None) and take the Ocean Beach cocktail while you are passing — it is the cheapest trophy on the list and the easiest to forget.

stages.title: Names, faces and set pieces
stages.blurb: Chapter 4 and the named story missions: Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. Watch the VCIA beat for the unscheduled-departure feat while you are inside it.

stages.title: Before the end of the road
stages.blurb: The point of no return. Before the final mission, sweep the trophies this guide flags as missable — partner feats, choices and one-time moments — then finish the story and take the gold.

stages.title: Strangers and loose ends
stages.blurb: With the credits rolled, work the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt. Eight finished strands also bank the silver Strangers & Freaks trophy.

stages.title: The great sweep
stages.blurb: The collectible lap of Leonida: card sets, WAiNK spots, meditation spots, vehicles to discover and register, and every last area of the map to uncover.

stages.title: Grinds, golds and scores
stages.blurb: The long tail: 250 stunts, gold at every shooting-range challenge, drone races, vaults, trucks, shops and the money trophies. Counters on the checklist keep these honest.

stages.title: One hundred percent
stages.blurb: Close out whatever the in-game 100% checklist still owes, take A Long Road, and the platinum — Vice Got a Price! — follows on its own.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum asks for nothing of its own: earn the other 54 trophies and it unlocks on the spot. Use the roadmap order in this guide — story first with the missables swept before the finale, then strands, collectibles and the counted grinds — and keep an eye on Next up, which always queues whatever stands between you and this one.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this trophy is simply a receipt for starting the game. Play it attentively rather than fast: it is the tutorial for the coast, the boats and the wanted level, and everything it teaches is reused for the fishing challenge and the partner-escape feats later.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission Chapter 1 offers and the trophy lands with the chapter card. Chapter missions cannot be missed — the story will not advance without them — so the only advice is to resist buying property or starting grinds until the chapter closes and both protagonists are properly introduced.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2's mission chain. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks and all. As the map opens during this chapter, it is a good moment to start the activity sampler (Master of None) in parallel, since new activity types tend to surface alongside new districts.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. By now the guide's counted trophies are all available to chip away at — stunts, challenges and vehicle discoveries accrue naturally while you travel between story beats, so route your drives through stunt spots instead of fast-travelling past them.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Several of the named mission trophies in this guide sit inside this stretch of the story, so if one of them has not unlocked by the chapter card, replay or check which named mission you have not yet finished before moving on.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story. Before you start the final mission, clear this guide's Missables page: choices and one-time moments flagged there belong to the road that ends here, and the official descriptions give no promise they return afterwards. The mission itself cannot be missed — it is the story's last door.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission; finish it and the trophy is yours. Named-mission trophies like this one are completion receipts rather than skill tests — if it has not popped, the mission is still waiting on your map or in your mission log.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story heist, The Cartel Heist. Heist completions in this series usually pay out and unlock in the debrief rather than at the loudest moment, so let the mission fully conclude before judging it missed. Its planning beats are also the natural rehearsal for the free-roam vault and armoured-truck trophies.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play when the story offers it. Like the other named-mission trophies it needs only completion, not a medal or a clean run, so play it for the story and let the tracker tick it off.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. If you are chasing the trophy list in order, this one sits in the same chapter stretch as VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory — clear them together and three bronzes land in one sitting.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown. While you are inside the VCIA beat, keep the Catch Me If You Can feat in mind: its official description asks for an unscheduled departure at VCIA, and this mission arc is the surest place the game gives you one. If the moment passes, that feat may need a mission replay.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory when the story presents it. It is a completion trophy like its neighbours: no medal, no timer, no optional objective is named in the official description, so a straightforward finish is enough.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist — not the trophy list, the in-game percentage. Work it backwards: open the completion screen, note what it still counts (typically story, strands, activities, collectibles and a spread of feats), and clear the cheapest gaps first. Most of its contents are trophies in this guide, so a nearly-full checklist here means a short road there.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps and stunt moves the game registers as stunts. This is a volume trophy, not a skill wall: start early, take ramps and jumps whenever a drive offers one, and keep the counter on the checklist honest so the last fifty do not come as a surprise. Repeatable stunt spots near your regular routes are worth more than a single heroic session.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 250)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once — PlayStation's count behind this one is nine types. You do not need to win or even finish well; a single honest attempt at each type registers it. The counter here tracks types tried, so tick each one off as you sample it and the trophy pops on the ninth.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 9 activity types)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Treat it as 42 small puzzles rather than one wall: learn each challenge's target order and medal threshold, gold them range by range, and log each gold in the counter. If one challenge resists, move on and return with a steadier hand — medals are permanent once earned, so progress never rolls back.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 42)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — a win at every site, not 14 wins anywhere. Run a sighting lap first where the course allows it: drone races are won on the racing line, not on recovery from crashes. Log each location in the counter as it falls.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 14 locations)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — re winning the same event does not add to the count, so breadth beats repetition. Work through the race list district by district, bring a vehicle suited to each class, and tick each new win in the counter; the trophy lands on the twentieth distinct event.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 20)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges reward patience over reflexes: match the bait and water the challenge sets, and do not strike at every ripple. If Cal wins a round, challenge him again — nothing in the official description limits your attempts, and the opening mission has already taught you the rod.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to credits. Any cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game on offer and play it through rather than sampling several. Arcades sit inside the world the story already walks you past — the next time one is in reach, stop and spend the five minutes.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's strand of stranger missions to its final entry and finish it. Stranger strands unlock in sequence — each finished job raises the next marker — so if Andy has gone quiet, check the map after sleeping or finishing another strand. This completion also counts toward the eight strands Strangers & Freaks counts.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand at its final mission. The title hints at water, so expect the strand to end where the boats are; bring a seaworthy vehicle when the last marker appears. Completion feeds the Strangers & Freaks count of eight strands.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: See Billy's strand through to its final mission. Stranger finales only appear after the earlier jobs in the same strand are done, so work them in order and let a day pass in game if a follow-up marker is slow to surface.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight whole stranger strands — a strand means every mission for that stranger, ending in the 'final mission' trophies this guide lists for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus the other strands the state offers. Count strands, not missions, in the counter; the silver lands on the eighth finale.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 8 strands)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's strand through its final mission. A strand about supply tends to involve moving goods under pressure, so keep a fast, sturdy vehicle garaged before you start the finale. The completion counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand at its final mission. If you are clearing strands in a batch, do this one in the same sweep as Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy — five finales in one stage of the roadmap keeps the Strangers & Freaks silver moving.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots scattered across Leonida. These are quiet places — viewpoints and high ground — so fold them into the exploration sweep for The Goodtime State: every new district you uncover, check its heights for a spot before moving on, and log each one in the counter.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 18 spots)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's commission and hunt the unique animal it names. 'Unique' is the operative word: this is one specific creature tied to Bret's strand, not any animal of its species, so follow the strand's own leads rather than hunting at random, and finish the strand to make sure the trophy registers.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three full Collectible Card sets. Sets, not loose cards: pick the three shortest sets the game offers and hunt those cards district by district, using the exploration sweep to pass every card spot on your route. A set only counts when its last card is in hand, so finish one before scattering attention across the rest.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 3 sets)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a coverage grind: the locations repeat the pattern of the meditation spots and card hunts, so run all three sweeps together — one pass per district, every marked spot visited, counter updated as you go — instead of three separate laps of the state.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 100 locations)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the game's Challenges. Challenges are the small posted tasks the world offers alongside its activities; accept them as they appear rather than hunting them cold, and favour the short ones early. The counter here is your friend — fifty sounds like a grind and is mostly just attendance.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 50)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as a precaution: the feat needs your partner beside you, and partner availability follows the story. Do it while the two protagonists are together rather than assuming a post-story chance — the official description does not promise one.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, raise a four-star wanted level, then lose it completely and escape. Plan the exit before the crime: a fast car, a route with tunnels, alleys or a vehicle swap, and no heroics at four stars. The trophy wants the level lost with the partner present — splitting up to escape separately is the classic way to do everything except earn it.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as a precaution, like Hot Together: it is a partner feat, so attempt it while the story keeps the pair together. The chain also breaks if the wanted level drops, which makes late-story free roam the risky time to try it.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in an unbroken chain with your partner, keeping a wanted level alive the whole time. Pick three shops close together on one street, keep the engine running between them, and rob briskly — the chain fails if the heat dies, so do not hide between shops. Small, fast and close beats big, slow and scattered.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — sit in or register each new model you meet. Wealthy districts, marinas, airports and the countryside each stock different traffic, so this fills in naturally during the exploration sweep; when a shape you do not recognise passes, take it for a short drive before moving on.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 100 vehicles)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies inside one Combat Focus activation. Do not try it against scattered targets: find a group — a gang operation or a crowded mission beat — line the shots up before you trigger Focus, and take the closest five. If a run ends at four, the setup was right and only the grouping was wrong; pick a denser crowd.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: The description ties this to VCIA, and the story's VCIA business is a one-way door: when the VCIA Takedown arc puts you there, look for the departure that is not on the schedule before the mission moves you on. A mission replay may be the only second chance.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA — the airport — by an unscheduled departure: not a booked flight, but a plane taken on your own initiative. The story's VCIA arc is the natural stage for it. When you find yourself on the airfield with aircraft in reach, take one and get airborne; the trophy is about the manner of leaving, not the destination.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke at the Rhino tank's expense and nothing more, so this guide is honest about the gap: the trophy concerns the Rhino, and the safe reading is to get into one and use it — survive the heat it draws and do some damage — when the game puts one in reach, most likely at high wanted levels or military sites. We flag the exact trigger as not yet pinned down rather than invent one.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description; the description itself is the only source for the trigger

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — in and out with no detection. Go at a quiet hour, watch the staff and camera pattern before you move, and leave the weapon holstered until the take is done: detection, not noise, is what the description forbids. If a robbery goes loud, finish it for the cash and try the next store quietly; the attempt costs nothing but time.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time — a robbery you are caught in does not count, so plan the exit before the entry: vehicle placed, route rehearsed, partner ready. Write a note on this trophy in the guide pane for each vault you clear — which approach worked is worth more than the cash, and the same route planning doubles for the gang-operations sweep in Pest Control.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 5 vaults)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armoured truck and get away. Trucks run routes through the city; intercept one where your escape is shortest, deal with the doors the way the game teaches in its heist beats, and be gone before the response escalates. One clean truck is all the trophy asks — greed on the second is optional.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover all 52 areas of Leonida on the map. This is the spine of the great sweep: ride every district, island and stretch of back country until no fog remains, and let the meditation spots, WAiNK locations and card hunts ride along on the same routes. Count areas as the map clears them, not as you guess them.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 52 areas)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation of each of the nine gangs — one per gang, not nine of the same. Spread the hits across the map as the exploration sweep identifies each gang's turf, and vary your approach: an operation robbed quietly still counts, and a loud one teaches the next gang nothing.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 9 gangs)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as a precaution: a quiet moment 'with a view' can hang on a place or a companion the story later changes. The description names Ocean Beach, which stays on the map — so the risk is low — but it costs two minutes to do it early, in stage 2, rather than test the question late.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail somewhere with a view, and drink it. That is the whole trophy: the cheapest on the list and, because nothing about it feels urgent, the one most often forgotten until the mop-up. Do it the first time the story takes you past Ocean Beach.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Inside a vehicle showroom, take a car and drive it out through the glass. 'In classic style' is the series' oldest joke — the showroom exit is the style. Choose a car pointed at the window, commit to the line, and do not brake for the display stands.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the description asks for the follow-through, so play the game properly rather than visiting the building. One honest game at the named alley is the natural reading; if the trophy is shy, finish the full game before judging it.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: The description is a riddle about the partnership, so we flag it: moments built on the two protagonists together belong to the story's road. If a shared activity or outing offers itself while you play the story, take it then; do not assume the same beat is offered after the finale.
trophies.guide: Another riddle description, and this guide will not fake a recipe: 'a partnership with mass appeal' points at the two protagonists doing something together that lands with a crowd. Play the story's shared beats and partner activities as they appear — hangouts, outings, joint feats — and this is the kind of trophy that pops mid-laugh rather than at a grind. We say plainly that the precise trigger is read from the description's wording, not yet confirmed in the game.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description; the description itself is the only source for the trigger

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices are the one currency the story never refunds: PlayStation tracks this to 500, so most choices must be small and repeatable — but make the big ones deliberately as they come, because a choice refused is still a choice you cannot revisit on this save.
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation counts them to 500, which tells you the game logs decisions large and small: dialogue picks, mission approaches, everyday either-ors. There is no wrong answer ('for better or worse'), so the only failure mode is autopilot. Keep choosing deliberately and the counter climbs on its own; the tracker here mirrors the count so you can see it move.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: 500)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as a precaution: a trophy about a second attempt implies a first attempt that can be spent. Where the game offers a retry-able challenge during the story, failing once on purpose is cheap insurance — after the credits, the same moment may not be on offer.
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on the second attempt after failing it once. The honest reading of a riddle description: somewhere the game grades an attempt, and this trophy rewards the comeback rather than the flawless run. If a story challenge lets you retry, one deliberate failure followed by success is the cheapest way to test it — and if it pops elsewhere, so much the better. We flag the exact stage as unconfirmed rather than invent one.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description; the description itself is the only source for the trigger

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A strangeness trophy can hang on a place, a time or a random event the game offers once. Treat odd sightings as appointments: when something strange starts, stay and watch it finish instead of driving on — leaving mid-event is the one reliable way to miss one of these.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Every game in this series hides its oddities off the beaten path — lights, sightings and encounters that ask only that you be there and pay attention. Explore at night, follow up the weird rumours strangers repeat, and when the world does something it should not, stop and watch. The trophy rewards curiosity, not combat.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by — a swing from a moving vehicle, not a collision. Ride or drive past a target on foot and time the melee as you pass; the vehicle must be moving and the hit must be the swing, so clipping them with the fender does not count. A quiet street and a slow pass make the timing easy.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — earnings through the laundering route specifically, not general income. Feed every marked bill the robberies in this guide produce into the laundry as you go, and the quarter million accrues across the vault, truck and operation hits instead of in one late grind. The counter takes dollars, so update it in round numbers after each wash.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: $250,000)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops in total — across all of them, so vehicles, clothes, weapons and services all feed the same pot. Never sell yourself short to save money in the mid-game: buy the good gear as it unlocks and this trophy lands as a by-product of playing well-equipped. Track the spend in round numbers in the counter.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles trophy list (progress target: $100,000)
Guide text: our own, from the official description

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties. This is a money gate, not a scavenger hunt: the garages are listed for sale as the game opens up, so the work is earning — heists, laundering and robberies from this guide's seventh stage — and then simply completing the set. Buy them as funds allow rather than saving for a single spree; each garage starts housing vehicles the day you own it.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Pair it with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover while sweeping the map, register on the spot before you move on, and both counters climb on the same drives. Ten is a small ask — the only way to miss it is to keep postponing the paperwork.
